hypothesis: A one-command heading-aware read returns the identical complete latest session entry with at least 50% fewer agent-visible bytes than the natural large-tail baseline and no additional task action.
limitations: One real file and session. The baseline tail size was agent-selected. Both task paths used one read action; measurement, reporting, tests, checkpoint and publication are additional experimental overhead. UTF-8 byte reduction does not establish token, latency, comprehension, decision-quality or general LLM improvement.
